race.comment: YOUCOMPLETEME (1) has been freshened with 43 days and steps out for the new stable after having excuses at Beaudesert. Has good early toe and give plenty of cheek. FRED'S MEMORY (2) was much better last start when finishing a close fifth last start after being in the firing line on the turn over 1200m at Grafton. Has peaks that measure up and is one of the main chances. DIAMONDSAREMIO (6) made a strong late bid but just failed to pick up the winner last start over 1100m at Grafton. Will get a tempo to suit and can pounce on them late. WHISKEY MISS (5) finished third last start at the first run back from a spell over 1215m at Grafton when she worked home well. Fitter for that and gets a key booking in Looker. In the mix. COPENHAGEN CAT (7) also wasn't far away first-up and is another likely improver worth including.
